Terry and Jack are the two big rep sellers, have a look at the sticky post for more info about them. 

Do you sell your reps?

Yeah that sucks, agree with other comments, if his jersey does arrive it will be a rep. Hopefully he can get a refund.

I think it is actually normal. I do lots of heat pressing too, and i think the marks are actually just the moisture coming out of the fabric under heat. It happens with all heat pressing, but will show up th most on dark colours. 
You are right if you heat too long you can damage it, but generally this will result in it shrinking - just going from the one photo they don’t look like they have shrunk in that square. 
I would say it will just naturally go away, or definitely go away after the first wash as the moisture content is restored.

Yes, wash them inside out, gentle cycle (in a wash bag if you have one), and cold water. And do not tumble try. 
Realistically a normal wash shouldn’t destroy them, but best to be on the safe side!
Has anyone got any tips on how to see the tracking info in English? Am i missing something obvious? My order is showing through the link and has a list of updates but i can’t see it in English?

Coming from Australia all of our sports jersey have massive sponsor logos, so a small patch on the jersey to me looks good and quiet authentic. I can see why some don’t like them, and i guess the demand is quite low, hence why the rep sellers aren’t too worried about having them on there accurately/at all.
Yeah ok, fair enough, i see your point. I’m lucky, as a spurs fan, all the swooshes are black and white for me so no problems from an authenticity front there!
Ok no worries that explains it!
Great review. I was interested in the hoodie, looks great. Thanks for the review and particularly the reference on sizing.

items.title: Terry three jersey review - Spurs and all stars
items.text: Terry three jersey review - Spurs and all stars

Communication 

Very easy, I contacted Terry through email (couldn’t get WeChat to work) and he responded in about an hours. Had the order all sorted and paid for in a few hours. 

10/10 

Cost 

Total cost was 405 RMB or  63 USD with the PayPal fee. This worked out for me at about $90 Australian. In Australia a swingman jersey costs $100, so all 3 came in cheaper than 1 genuine one here! 

10/10 

Shipping 

Order was placed on the 10th of April and arrived on the 24th, so two weeks exactly. Pretty fast and i was able to track the order via Terry’s new tracking. 

9/10 

Jerseys 

All 3 are XL. My legit jerseys are also XL but are a bit big so I went for XL for the reps. Fit great, actually pretty similar to a real XL but I haven’t actually compared them. 

I wanted to get the sponsor patch on all jerseys but Terry said he couldn’t do it for the spurs jerseys. It’s a shame but not a big deal. 

Spurs Statement jersey 

Really happy with this one, looks great. The 8 on the front mightn’t be quite straight but not noticeable. A couple of loose threads but great quality. 

9/10 

Spurs City jersey 

Probably my favourite of the 3, really like this one. No issues from me. 

9/10 

All stars 2019 white 

This is a custom name and number. These has been reviewed to death so not much to add. Only thing I noticed is the stars on the sides are sublimated into the jersey, on the retail version these are heat pressed. Looks great. 

9/10 

Overall very happy. I got a pretty long future list or jerseys to get which I’ll get through Terry predominantly. I have a custom earned spurs on the way as well as a couple of older stitched jerseys from Jack which I’ll review when they arrive. 

Let me know if you have any questions.
I have only shipped to Australia, but takes about two weeks from shipping to receive the order. Customs is usually only a day or 2 of this. So from my experience you should be fine.

I used Terry’s tracking site - http://terry.dh.cx/ - Just put your name in with no spaces. This gives you the tracking but in Chinese. You can copy the tracking number though and us a site like 17track to track it and it works really well.
Ahh good pick up, didn’t notice that but you’re right. Still happy with them though.
Looks good to me.
Rubio jersey looks great!
No sorry, never used it. How much does Terry charge for rush shipping out of interest?
Not sure where to get them sorry, but you’re right that page is dodgy, I would not buy from there at all! You probably won’t get anything but if you do it will be a rep.

Yeah that’s a bummer, I agree you should get a refund or replacement on both. The font on the Ingles one is 50-50 i think as applebcyz notes, this can be a problem with any reps, but the wrong colour on the name is just a mistake i reckon. Fingers crossed it gets sorted for you.

Yes agree PORTLAND looks a bit crooked and probably worth mentioning to Terry. 

As an aside applebcyz, i wonder if there is a some value in a post or some guidance around QC checks? You made a really good point in a previous post (sorry can’t remember which one), that basically remember you are QCing against what is in Terry’s Yupoo, not against a retail version, i.e. most of these jerseys have some issues with them and thats a known thing when buying.
No worries, i think you do a tremendous job as the mod, so sorry didn’t want to put more work on you, but have just noticed lots of people asking for QC checks of late!
Thanks so much, great work!

Firstly thanks for taking the time to put this together (and more generally the time and effort you put into this for us as the mod). 

I don’t have any suggested changes but just want to say that i support what you have written. 

I do think that this is a good forum to ask advice from others about QC checks etc, but in reality almost every jersey is going to have some issues, so it is important to note what is within the expected errors. I think also for people buying a jersey, have a look at the reviews etc (where possible) and it is realistic to expect a jersey as good as what you see in these reviews, but not what you get retail. 

Final thing, as you note lots of this will be subjective, so we can probably add/modify this list as we go if new issues come up.
Yes agree

Not sure what is happening. I use email and have never had him take more than a couple of hours to respond. Just keep it short and sweet would be my only advice, and if ordering i include pictures of the jerseys i’m after.
Definitely go heat pressed if your after a modern jersey. I have bought custom name/number from Terry, looks great, he did an awesome job.

I don’t think is any cause for concern. It is moisture coming out of the fabric from the heat pressing - it shows up more clearly on dark jerseys but will happen on all jerseys. 

It will go away after the first wash (if not before). There was a post about this a few weeks ago from memory with some more detail.
